chunks: (And the Lord) said: "O Noah, disembark with peace and safety from Us and blessings on you and the people with you. As for some (of them), We shall bestow advantages for a time, then send a grievous punishment on them."
ai.seo_question: What did God command Noah to do after the flood, and what was promised to the disbelievers?
ai.summary: In this verse, God commands Noah to descend from the Ark, bestowing peace and blessings upon him and the nations that will follow, while noting that some disbelievers will enjoy temporary worldly life before facing painful punishment. This highlights the dual outcome of the flood: salvation for the faithful and retribution for the arrogant, a theme central to the narrative of Noah in Shia exegesis as a precursor to the ultimate victory of the righteous.
